pages.text: $(bold)A critical difference from vanilla:$()$(br2)The $(bold)Nether is Tier 3$() content. The $(bold)End is Tier 4$() content.$(br2)Nether portals require a $(t3)Tier 3$() progression token to activate. End portals require a stabilized Eye of Ender recipe gated to $(t4)Tier 4$(). This is intentional — both dimensions are significantly more dangerous than their vanilla equivalents in this pack.

$(bold)Tier 2 Dimensions$()$(br2)$(bold)Twilight Forest$() — Dense, dark, ambush-heavy. Bosses guard progression. Home of the first $(thing)Simply Swords$() uniques.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies$() (Everbright + Everdawn) — Elemental combat. Mobs deal elemental damage that bypasses standard armor.$(br2)$(bold)The Aether$() — Aerial warfare. Vertical combat, thin platforms, falling is lethal. Ranged builds shine here.

$(bold)Tier 3 Dimensions$()$(br2)$(bold)The Undergarden$() — Toxic attrition. Constant poison pressure, environmental hazards. Survival builds matter.$(br2)$(bold)Deeper and Darker$() — Horror survival. Noise attracts mobs. Sculk mechanics. Stealth has value here.$(br2)$(bold)The Nether$() — Relentless aggression. Everything is permanently aggro. Piglins hunt in packs.$(br2)$(bold)The Abyss: The Other Side$() — Optional $(t3)Tier 3$() dimension.

$(bold)Tier 4 Dimensions$()$(br2)$(bold)Deep Aether$() — Ascension trial. Combines aerial combat with elite mob AI. Celestial Events every 20 minutes empower all mobs.$(br2)$(bold)The End$() — Three escalating zones: Outer Islands → Deep End / End Cities → Dragon's Domain. Difficulty increases sharply between zones. $(warn)The End is designed to kill you.$() $(italic)Prepare accordingly.$()
